message: Hi, I'm a student with a machine learning certification background. My overall academic average is 72.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Computer Architecture and developer. I want to become a Database Manager. My family can afford at most about USD 10700 per year. I live in Pune. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in Computer Architecture and developer roles

explanation:
This program offers the highest median starting salary at $15,951 USD, which aligns with your priority of securing a good job after graduation. It requires a minimum grade of 71%, which meets your current academic average of 72.8%, and accepts students without a mandatory CS background. The main trade-off is the location in Chennai, moving you away from your preferred Pune area.

This program boasts an excellent placement rate of 87% and a strong median starting salary of $13,436 USD. It requires a minimum grade of 72%, which you meet with your 72.8% average, and accepts students with a CS background. While located in Mumbai, its high job prospects make it a top recommendation for career focus.

This is the best option if staying near Pune is your highest priority, as the program is located right in Pune. It has a solid placement rate of 86% and requires a minimum grade of 70%, which you exceed. The main trade-off here is that its median starting salary ($12,541 USD) is lower compared to some other options.

Located in Mumbai, this program offers a good balance of job prospects with a placement rate of 83% and a median starting salary of $12,637 USD. It requires a CS background, which you possess, and its tuition is manageable at $3,150 USD annually. This makes it a strong alternative if Mumbai is acceptable and you are prioritizing job stability.
